items.title: The describing verb follows the action
items.caption: The particle, person, and action keep their places. The added describing verb says how the action was done.

states.label: Action described
states.note: The describing verb *fiafia* follows the action verb *foʻi*.

items.title: The want word comes before the action
items.caption: The want word *fia* stands directly before the action verb.

states.label: Wanted action
states.note: Under the past particle, *fia* says the action was wanted.

items.title: Match each verb to its meaning
items.intro: Pair each Samoan word with the meaning printed in this chapter.

pairs.en: want: goes in front of the verb and says the action was wanted
strong (after a verb: hard, with strength)
